source.test: createNewServer(name:...) -- imported world metadata overrides wizard-chosen values

notes: `effectiveDifficulty = importedMetadata.difficulty ?? difficulty`, same pattern for gamemode (lines 160-161), and `effectiveWorldSeed = normalizedWorldSeed ?? importedMetadata.seed` (line 162) -- a backup zip or existing folder that carries its own level.dat metadata always wins over whatever the create-server wizard's form fields said, for all three fields. A fresh world source has no imported metadata (`WorldSlotManager.ImportedWorldMetadata()`, line 154), so the wizard's values pass through untouched in that case.
